description.en: Wakes your phone and your browsers when something happens, through push.waifucave.com. The push says only how many updates there are; your phone then fetches what happened from your own computer, so waifucave never sees it.

note.en: Waits for the MOSS phone apps to sign up for push, and for waifucave push (push.waifucave.com) to be running.

description.en: For development profiles only: a local push emulator.
